metadata.name: realtime-inbox-listener
metadata.description: Invisible utility component that opens a Supabase Realtime broadcast subscription on a per-user channel ('user-<userId>') and fires events whenever a new chat message, a read-receipt, or a lesson change is pushed to that user.
features: Subscribes to a Supabase Realtime broadcast channel scoped to a user id
Fires a messageReceived event with the new message payload
Fires a messagesRead event when the other person reads your messages
Fires a lessonChanged event when a lesson is booked, cancelled, or rescheduled for this user
Re-subscribes automatically when the userId prop changes
Cleans up the subscription on unmount

properties.name: userId
properties.description: The logged-in user's id; the component listens on the 'user-<userId>' realtime channel.

events.name: messageReceived
events.description: Fires the instant a new message is broadcast to this user's channel.

events.name: messagesRead
events.description: Fires when the other person in a conversation reads your messages.

events.name: lessonChanged
events.description: Fires when a lesson affecting this user is booked, cancelled, or rescheduled.

specifications: Renders no visible UI — place it once anywhere on the page.
Requires userId to be a non-empty string/number to actually subscribe.
Pairs with backend functions calling realtime.send(...,'new_message'|'messages_read'|'lesson_changed', 'user-<recipientId>', false).
Always subscribes regardless of editor isEditing state.

examples.description: Listen for the current user's incoming messages, read receipts, and lesson changes
